questionText:
Consider the following two sets:

Set XSet Y
P. Lexical Analyzer1. Abstract Syntax Tree
Q. Syntax Analyzer2. Token
R. Intermediate Code Generator3. Parse Tree
S. Code Optimizer4. Constant Folding

Which one of the following options is the CORRECT match from Set X to Set Y?
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

1. Lexical Analyzer (P): The lexical analyzer scans the source program and groups character sequences into tokens. Hence, P matches with 2 (Token).

2. Syntax Analyzer (Q): The syntax analyzer (parser) processes the stream of tokens and constructs a parse tree according to the language grammar rules. Hence, Q matches with 3 (Parse Tree).

3. Intermediate Code Generator (R): The intermediate code generator transforms the syntactic representation into an intermediate representation such as an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) or three-address code. Hence, R matches with 1 (Abstract Syntax Tree).

4. Code Optimizer (S): The code optimizer performs transformations to improve code execution speed or reduce space, one common technique being constant folding. Hence, S matches with 4 (Constant Folding).

Therefore, the correct mapping is P – 2; Q – 3; R – 1; S – 4, which corresponds to Option (B).
